name: Load CT scans (DICOM discs, NIfTI, NRRD, MHA)
summary: Turns any CT source (a CD/DVD export with DICOMDIR, DICOM/ and IHE_PDI/, loose DICOM, NIfTI, NRRD, MHA, zips) into one volume per case, <case>/ct.nii.gz: series grouped by their DICOM IDs, copies read
help: Where the scans come from (Source): Files wired in (a Dataset block, a download, a zip of a disc); Folder on the worker (the full path as the worker sees it, such as D:\CT2013); Upload from the View (the Load a CT view sends the series you tick in your browser; wire this block's Live telemetry, through a Telemetry block on channel ct_load, to the view's Live input). DICOM is grouped by Series Instance UID wherever the files are, so a series split over folders is one scan and the IHE_PDI copy of a disc is read once; DICOMDIR, pictures, web pages, PDFs, localisers, dose reports and structured reports are skipped. Series: the best CT series of each study (axial, slices of 3 mm or thinner, covering the most), every CT series, or only those named (series numbers, descriptions or UIDs). Pixels are read with GDCM (compressed transfer syntaxes too) and written in Hounsfield units, 16-bit. No patient tag is copied: the NIfTI files hold pixels and geometry only; cases are named after the series (A_S3_Abdomen_1.5_B30f: study A, series 3). The Series table lists every series found and what happened to it. Wire Scans into Segment CT automatically.

inputs.label: Files
inputs.help: Source Files wired in: the scans, in any layout (DICOM folders, NIfTI/NRRD/MHA, zips)

outputs.label: Scans
outputs.help: <case>/ct.nii.gz, one per scan chosen, in HU

outputs.label: Series
outputs.help: series.csv: every series found (study, number, description, modality, images, slice thickness, coverage, folders) and what happened to it

params.label: Source
params.help: Upload from the View: the run waits for the files the Load a CT view sends

params.label: Folder on the worker
params.help: Source Folder on the worker: the full path as the worker sees it (D:\CT2013, \\server\share\CT2013, /data/ct/CT2013); every file under it is looked at

params.label: Series
params.default: The best CT series of each study
options: The best CT series of each study
params.help: Best: axial, slices of 3 mm or thinner, covering the most of the body, then the thinnest

params.label: Series to load
params.help: Series Only these series: numbers, descriptions (or part of them) or UIDs, separated by commas, such as 3, 5 or Abdomen 1.5

params.label: Modalities
params.help: Kinds of scans kept, separated by commas: CT, or CT, MR (MR needs the segmentation task total_mr)

params.label: Fewest images
params.help: Series with fewer images are left out (single images, short sequences)

params.label: Wait for the upload (minutes)
params.help: Upload from the View: how long the run waits for the files, and for each pause while they come
